## Result

The posting cycle ran live on the Bench Tester account, exactly as briefed:

1. **Post created** with the exact text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.` and the image `./cover.png` (1200x675 PNG, title `Harbor Day 2026` rendered in large white text on a dark blue background), with alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. **That post deleted** via its options menu → "Delete post" → confirmed in the "Delete this post?" dialog. Only that post was removed.

## How I know it is right

- **Image**: generated with PIL at exactly 1200x675; `cover.png` is in the workspace.
- **Post text**: the composer's rich-text editor showed `value="Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on."` in the snapshot before publishing.
- **Alt text**: after upload, the snapshot showed `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."` — the alt text I entered in the "Add alt text" dialog was applied to the live post.
- **Post was live**: after publishing, the snapshot showed the new post at the top of the feed with the image and correct alt text.
- **Deletion**: after confirming the delete dialog, the snapshot showed no "Harbor Day" post; the feed's top Bench Tester post is the original "Hello from the Bluehaze test account..." post, and all other users' posts (Otto Fenwick, Mara Quill) are unchanged.
- **Cleanup**: both browser tabs I opened are closed.

## Assumptions

- The brief said "an image you make" — I generated `cover.png` locally with PIL (no external assets) and uploaded it through the app's "Upload image" control.
- "Only that post" deleted: I used the per-post options menu on the new post specifically, not any bulk action, so nothing else was touched.
- The app was already signed in to @tester.bluehaze.test as stated; I did not log in or out.
